claimPolicy: This source-controlled file is a fail-closed policy baseline and must not be mutated to approve its own Git commit. Production approval is supplied as an external exact-commit attestation from a production environment whose protection and approval rules are separately verified. Real patient data remains blocked until the separate post-deploy production attestation passes.

requiredGates.label: CNYOS Owner subscription ON/OFF enforced by database authorization
Authenticated staging E2E for every role
LINE OA signed callback, consent, revoke, QR expiry and replay denial
Encrypted Google Drive export and isolated restore drill with measured RPO/RTO
Privacy, security, clinical-safety and applicable legal review with zero unresolved release blockers
Required migrations applied to isolated staging with migration and rollback evidence
Independent Quality SOP and producer-versus-approver segregation verified
Managed database backup/PITR configuration verified separately from Google Drive export
Production monitoring, alert ownership, incident response, containment, rollback and recovery procedures verified with retained evidence
Exact release-candidate provenance, automated checks, review status, main-branch protection and production-environment protection/approval verified before production deployment

postDeploymentGate.label: Exact production commit/tree, runtime surface, security headers and forbidden-path denial attested after deployment
